mapper.select: SELECT A.FINPROD_ID, A.FINPROD_TYPE, A.FINPROD_ABBR, A.FINPROD_NAME, A.PROFIT_TYPE, A.COUPON_SPECIES, A.CHL_FINPROD_ID, A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, A.ISSUE_PRICE, A.ISSUE_AMT, A.CCY, A.BLN_AREA, A.TRADE_MARKET, A.CALENDAR_ID, A.ISSUE_TYPE, A.ISSUER, A.IDATE, A.VDATE, A.MDATE, A.ACTMDATE, A.IS_CHL, A.IS_SUS, A.IS_RIGHT, A.P_FINPROD_ID, A.O_FINPROD_ID, A.O_FINPROD_TYPE, A.CAPI_INCOME_FEATURE FROM BOK_BOOKSET B INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT A ON B.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = A.FINPROD_ID WHERE B.BOOKSET_ID = (select F_PROD_ID from rep_prod_info where PROD_ID = #{booksetId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND B.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = #{acctSubjectType}
